notes.title: Underdose Cinematic & Gameplay Trailer now available! 🔥🎥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191617/3a5fb4b4d9aef6f257f6378f8879963ad456daef.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi there![/b]👋

Today you can take a look at the [b]cinematic trailer[/b] and [b]gameplay[/b] for the [b]Underdose game[/b]!🎥

[b]The cinematic trailer[/b] reveals the world presented in the game and two main characters. It also shows an underground laboratory where mysterious scenes between a man and a woman take place. 
[previewyoutube=iBxvtTADGA4;full][/previewyoutube]

After this sneak peek [b]you can jump to see the gameplay trailer[/b], which is also already available.🔥

[previewyoutube=3bQfW6DvJ7A;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Remember to follow and add the game to your wishlist![/b]📝
